title: Ice Nine
sources: own knowledge of the game (facts written for this def)
notes: Genre: Shooter. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text: A shoot, B action/jump, R strafe, L switch weapon. First-person missions as a CIA agent.
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text: Health and armour; medkits and armour vests refill them.
widgets.label: Health

widgets.text: Strafe around corners; head-height aim deals more damage. Watch for snipers in open areas.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: Story missions in sequence, each with objectives (reach, destroy, rescue).
widgets.label: Structure

widgets.text: Pistol, SMG, shotgun, rifle and explosives found in missions; ammo from fallen enemies.
widgets.label: Weapons

widgets.text: Objectives and intel items per mission.
widgets.label: Collect

widgets.text: Complete every mission to stop the Ice-9 conspiracy.
widgets.label: Goal
